request.text: wardog ran an Exchange exploit script on MXS01 that planted a web shell in OWA, and the shell is already running commands. Disable account wardog.

package.rationale: wardog's elevated python ran public-poc.py against the local Exchange (localhost, wardog@azsentinel.local) and made HTTPS requests to it; seconds later ohyeah.aspx appeared in OWA's auth folder and the OWA worker w3wp.exe started cmd /c whoami. A web shell was planted through the exploit; disable wardog.
